questions.question: How should the useful anchors enter the repo?

options.label: Backlog item only (Recommended)
options.description: One BK item listing the shortlist and where each would apply. No doc changes now. Fits the rule that docs describe current state, not intent.

options.label: Inline at point of use
options.description: Name each anchor in the doc that owns the mechanism (e.g. 'Rule 7 is BLUF' in CONTENT-RULES.md, EARS in spec template, Chicago/London in TESTING.md). Needs a branch, trace, CHANGELOG.

options.label: Central vocabulary section
options.description: One glossary in sdd/CLAUDE-REFERENCE.md that maps each anchor to its repo mechanism. Single place, but one more indirection.

options.label: Nothing
options.description: Keep this as conversation only.
